## MEDIUM IMPACT

### Component: Home Overview View Strategy (`home-overview-view-strategy.ts`)

**What changed:** The favorites section in the auto-generated Home Overview dashboard now calls `computeFavoriteCardConfig()` instead of always emitting a bare `tile` card with `state_content: ["state", "area_name"]` and `show_entity_picture: true`. For camera entities specifically, the helper emits a `picture-entity` card with `show_name: false`, `show_state: false`, and `grid_options: { columns: 6, rows: 2 }` instead of a tile.

**What it affects in ha-lcars:** The preamble's `card-mod-card-yaml` (`&card-mod-card`) applies LCARS styling based on card type classes such as `:host(.type-tile)` and `:host(.type-picture-entity)`. The tile-specific button/bar/lozenge shape rules, the `> .content > #controls` / `> .content > #info` selectors, and the `> .more-info { display: none }` rule inside `.button-small` all target tile card internals. A camera entity that previously rendered as a tile (receiving all tile-targeted LCARS CSS) will now render as a `picture-entity` card, which has different internal DOM structure and will not match the same selectors.

**Suggested fix:** Audit any LCARS dashboard configurations that place camera entities in the favorites section. If the `picture-entity` card layout looks wrong under LCARS styling, add an explicit `card-mod-card` rule scoped to `.type-picture-entity` to normalize sizing, background, and text variable overrides, mirroring the existing tile handling. At minimum, verify the `--lcars-primary-text`, `--card-background-color`, and border-radius variables resolve correctly inside a `picture-entity` card's shadow DOM in the favorites context.

---

### Component: `common-controls-section-strategy.ts` (Usage Prediction Strategy)

**What changed:** The usage prediction "common controls" section also migrated to `computeFavoriteCardConfig()`. Camera entities in this automatically generated section will now render as `picture-entity` cards with the 6×2 `grid_options` layout instead of tile cards.

**What it affects in ha-lcars:** Same as above — the LCARS tile-targeted card-mod selectors (`#controls`, `#info`, `span.state`, `> ha-state-icon`) will not apply to `picture-entity` cards. The 6-column span may also alter grid layout geometry in ways that interact with LCARS section padding (e.g., `hui-masonry-view { padding-right: 23px }` and `hui-panel-view` margin rules in `card-mod-root-yaml`).

**Suggested fix:** Same remediation as the Home Overview entry above. No urgency unless camera entities appear in the usage-prediction auto-generated sections in active LCARS deployments.

## LOW IMPACT

### Component: `home-assistant.ts` (More Info URL Handling)

**What changed:** The `hash` parameter was removed from `decodeMoreInfoUrl()` and from the `showMoreInfoDialog()` call. The `more-info-header-background: rgba(25, 25, 25)` variable and `card-mod-more-info-yaml` rules in ha-lcars are not affected — this is a pure URL-routing behavior change with no visual surface.

**Suggested fix:** No fix needed. Informational only.

---

### Component: `favorite-cards.ts` (New Helper Module)

**What changed:** A new shared helper `computeFavoriteCardConfig` was extracted. It introduces `picture-entity` card type emission for cameras with explicit `grid_options`. This is a new code path the theme could optionally style.

**Suggested fix:** No fix needed immediately. If the theme maintainers wish to provide explicit LCARS styling for auto-generated `picture-entity` cards in the favorites context (matching the aesthetic of button/bar tiles), a new `card-mod-card` block targeting `.type-picture-entity` could be added. No current ha-lcars rule is broken by this addition.
